notes: Recruiting takes fewer taps. Build my board puts out offers to the best realistic targets at your biggest needs in one tap, and Work my board spends your hours on the recruits who can still swing, scouting the ones who decide soon first. Your phone: every waiting text now sits at the top of the Recruit tab, so you can answer them all in one place. The board shows 30 recruits at a time with a Show more button, and rows are easier to read on a phone. NIL retention buttons no longer get squeezed on small screens. On a wide screen there is only one Sim button now; the second one shows up in the tab bar only after you scroll past the header.
